notes.title: Version 4.3.5
notes.notes:
Game Changes:
-Improve FPS 5-10% increase
-Updated GMS Engine
-Optimizations

Bug Fix:
-Civilians now get off the plane instead of Franks home
-Fixed Crashes with Walls
-Fixed Night time to adjust to every screen size

Next update will be a fun and exciting update!

notes.title: Version 4.1.1
notes.notes:
Game Changes
(Freemium Users) - Ad Timer Set to just 10 Minutes always
(Freemium Users) - You can now see the timer
-Generator cost changed for $5000 to $3000
-Less claimable Marines spawn on The Lab
-Turret price increased from $50 to $75
-Exfil Backup Increased from $300 to $400
-Buffed Generator Output from 1-20 to 1-40 Material
-More friendly units on outpost

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed Cars removing civilians
-Fixed Material Generator from not working on outpost map
-Fixed Collector in picking up material when zombies are in no sight
-Fixed night feeders from spawning in water

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
-Fixed Civilian not turning into a zombie when attacked by zombies
-Fixed Militia from turning into zombie when killed by raider
-fixed minor crash

notes.notes:

notes.title: Christmas Update! 0.4.0.7
notes.notes:
New Features:
-You can now keep bodies from despawning located in gamesettings
-New Unit added Marksman Soldier

Game Changes:
-Christmas is here!! Snow everywhere!

Bug Fixes:
-You can now remove preplaced walls in freeplay
-Fixed the ability to exfil out of new hudson with your units
-Fixed players from deleting their base on accident
-Fixed tutorial text from sticking on screen

PC Changes:
-You can now change Screen mode (Windowed/Fullscreen)
